title: Right-horn filtration of boundary prisms
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices, horns and degreewise products of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and colimits of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Put $\partial\Delta^m=\bigcup_{a=0}^m d_a\Delta^{m-1}$ for $m\geq1$, and $\partial\Delta^0=\varnothing$. For every integer $m\geq0$ there are simplicial subsets
$$ X_0\subseteq X_1\subseteq\cdots\subseteq X_{m+1}=\Delta^1\times\Delta^m $$
with $X_0=(\{1\}\times\Delta^m)\cup(\Delta^1\times\partial\Delta^m)$, such that, for each $0\leq q\leq m$, the square with top row $\Lambda_{q+1}^{m+1}\hookrightarrow\Delta^{m+1}$ and bottom row $X_q\hookrightarrow X_{q+1}$ is a pushout. The composite of the right vertical map with $X_{q+1}\hookrightarrow\Delta^1\times\Delta^m$ is $\sigma_q:\Delta^{m+1}\to\Delta^1\times\Delta^m$, with vertices $\sigma_q(j)=(0,j)$ for $j\leq q$ and $\sigma_q(j)=(1,j-1)$ for $j>q$; the left vertical map is its restriction to the horn. Moreover $X_{q+1}=X_q\cup\operatorname{im}(\sigma_q)$.
